notes: Line endings carry emotion again, your way: no mark = normal, ! = excited or mad, ? = questions, … = flustered, hesitant or confessing, ~ = playful now and then, — = cut off, a comma = serious moments only, a period = only to end a conversation. The old rule told the AI to end calm lines with a comma, and the app was turning sentence breaks into commas, so everything came out as flat commas and periods. That's gone: '...' becomes the real …, and the example lines the AI copies from (world examples, sheets, voice cards) no longer end in commas and periods. Texts follow the same system
